body.input: Jane, the knockout stage is here! Eight teams left, and the first quarterfinal is Top Esports versus Invictus Gaming on the third of November!
Yes, Paul, and Gen.G play LYON on the fourth. But let’s not pretend you’re not just waiting for Karmine Corp to face T1 on the sixth.
Of course I am! Karmine Corp made history—first French org in the knockout stage since Against All Authority in 2011!
And they scraped through the Swiss stage at three wins, two losses. Beat Anyone’s Legend, then CTBC Flying Oyster and Movistar KOI to qualify.
Scraped through? They fought hard! And now they get T1, the three-time defending champions.
Yes, T1, who strolled into the knockout stage with three wins and one loss. Alongside Gen.G and Dplus KIA, both undefeated in Swiss.
Undefeated? Fine, but LYON made it too—their first Worlds playoffs ever!
And G2 Esports? Out. Movistar KOI? Out. Hanwha Life? Out. The field is thinning fast.
And the final’s at Barclays Center on the fourteenth of November. Five million dollar prize pool, one million for the winner!
Yes, yes. All best-of-five from here. Now, let’s see if Karmine Corp can actually trouble T1.
Oh, they’ll surprise you. Just watch.
We’ll see. Back to you after the break.
